weekly_theme.summary: 這段期間沒有特別重大的星象事件，是適合按自己步調安排生活的一週。

aries.horoscope: 起初，玻璃杯可能看起來是半空的，但仔細看看或改變你的觀點，你會發現它實際上是半滿的。您今天可能會感到有點沮喪，可能是因為技術問題或溝通中斷。與其讓它給你帶來壓力，不妨將此視為放鬆身心的絕佳機會，特別是暫時可能無法達到生產力。
aries.horoscope_en: At first, it might seem like the glass is half empty, but take a closer look—or shift your perspective—and you'll realize it's actually half full. You might be feeling a bit of frustration today, perhaps due to technical issues or communication breakdowns. Instead of letting it stress you out, view this as a perfect opportunity to unwind, especially since productivity may be out of reach for now.
aries.lucky_disclaimer: 幸運色／幸運時間由本 App 依星座與日期自動生成，非真實命理來源，僅供參考娛樂。

taurus.horoscope: 今天，金牛座，你會發現自己正在面對各種個人和財務挑戰。您可能會接到銀行的電話，或注意到自動櫃員機單據上的一些相關數字。保持冷靜；這些問題最終會對你有利。在個人方面，準備好接受一些關於你認為自己親密認識的人的驚人啟示。你曾經認為很強的聯繫可能不如你想像的那麼親密。
taurus.horoscope_en: Today, Taurus, you’ll find yourself navigating a variety of personal and financial challenges. You might receive a call from your bank or notice some concerning figures on an ATM slip. Stay calm; these issues will ultimately work out in your favor. On the personal front, prepare for some surprising revelations about someone you believed you knew intimately. A bond you once thought was strong may not be as close as you imagined.

gemini.horoscope: 雙子座，當命運對你所愛的人微笑時，它會產生波浪，也會讓你振作起來。令人興奮的變化即將到來，雖然一切都變得更好，但有時可能會感到壓倒性的步伐。你可能會發現自己有點迷失方向，幾乎沒有機會喘口氣。請記住，即使是好運也需要一段調整期。讓自己有恩典來適應這些新的發展。
gemini.horoscope_en: When fortune smiles upon someone dear to you, Gemini, it creates waves that can uplift you too. Exciting changes are on the horizon, and while they are all for the better, the pace may feel overwhelming at times. You might find yourself slightly disoriented, with little opportunity to catch your breath. Remember, even good fortune requires an adjustment period. Allow yourself the grace to adapt to these new developments.

cancer.horoscope: 巨蟹座，你的職業生涯正在發生變化。隨著一些重要項目的成功完成，您的辛勤工作終於得到了認可。潛在的獎勵或晉升可能即將推出！您的技術訣竅和快速學習技能使您能夠完美地擔任新職位。把握機會！
cancer.horoscope_en: Change is brewing in your professional life, Cancer. With the successful completion of some significant projects, your hard work is finally being acknowledged. A potential bonus or promotion could be on the way! Your knack for technology and your quick learning skills position you perfectly for a newly available role. Seize this opportunity!

leo.horoscope: 盡管聽起來很狂野，獅子座，現在是組織你一直夢寐以求的旅程的完美時機！冒險精神正在召喚你，雖然你可能會遇到一些障礙，但你已經準備好擺脫日常生活。這個世界浩瀚無垠，充滿奇蹟，你渴望花一些時間去探索它！
leo.horoscope_en: As wild as it may sound, Leo, now is the perfect time to organize that journey you've been dreaming about! The spirit of adventure is beckoning you, and while there may be a few hurdles in your way, you're ready to break free from your routine. The world is vast and full of wonders, and you're eager to carve out some time to explore it!

virgo.horoscope: 你的好運即將來臨，處女座！如今，您的工作、職業或環境都會發生重大變化。無論這些變化如何展開，它們肯定會帶來積極的結果。運氣就在你身邊，你即將達到更高的境界。花點時間欣賞這段時間，因為你很快就會發現自己正處於活動的旋風中！
virgo.horoscope_en: Good fortune is on the horizon for you, Virgo! Today, expect significant shifts in your work, career, or surroundings. No matter how these changes unfold, they are sure to bring positive outcomes. Luck is on your side, and you're on the verge of achieving even greater heights. Take a moment to appreciate this time, as you'll soon find yourself in the midst of a whirlwind of activity!

libra.horoscope: 天秤座，你正處於變革的邊緣，變革發生在你內部和周圍。無論是搬遷到其他地區，還是計劃前往遙遠的地方探險，都越來越渴望擴展你的體驗。這趟旅程也會為你的生活帶來新面孔。當您踏入這個令人興奮的新篇章時，這些全新的聯繫將成為過程中的寶貴導師。
libra.horoscope_en: Libra, you're on the brink of transformation, with shifts occurring both within and around you. There's a growing desire to expand your experiences, whether that means relocating to a different area or planning an adventure to distant places. This journey will also bring new faces into your life. As you step into this exciting new chapter, these fresh connections will serve as valuable mentors along the way.

scorpio.horoscope: 今天，天蠍座，愛在你周圍綻放。期待目睹你與所珍惜的人之間的聯繫得到顯著提升。您可能會收到令人愉快的驚喜，例如一束鮮花或由衷的讚美。工作氛圍同樣正面，同事和技術完美同步運作。
scorpio.horoscope_en: Today, Scorpio, love is blossoming all around you. Expect to witness a significant uplift in your connections with those you cherish. You might receive a delightful surprise, like a bouquet of flowers or a heartfelt compliment. The atmosphere at work is equally positive, with both colleagues and technology operating in perfect sync.

sagittarius.horoscope: 你的專注力和細緻度達到歷史新高。這種新發現的能量爆發可以讓您以比想像中更快的速度完成一些正在進行的專案。射手座，現在，孩子們正成為你生活中的中心舞臺。有沒有一個特定的孩子可以多花一點時間和精力？你的感情和鼓勵比你想像的更重要。
sagittarius.horoscope_en: Your concentration and meticulousness are at an all-time high. This newfound burst of energy allows you to wrap up some ongoing projects faster than you thought possible. Right now, children are taking center stage in your life, Sagittarius. Is there a specific child who could use a little more of your time and care? Your affection and encouragement hold more significance than you might think.

capricorn.horoscope: 摩羯座，避免讓別人的負面情緒挫傷你的精神。請記住，提振他們的情緒不是你的職責；他們的感受是他們要管理的。你今天可能會感到一絲焦慮，屈服於周圍的陰霾將無法為你提供良好的服務。請放心，整體氛圍將在短短幾天內明亮起來。
capricorn.horoscope_en: Capricorn, steer clear of letting the negativity of others dampen your spirits. Remember, it's not your duty to lift their mood; their feelings are theirs to manage. You might feel a touch of anxiety today, and succumbing to the gloom around you won't serve you well. Rest assured, the overall vibe is set to brighten up in just a few days.

aquarius.horoscope: 水瓶座，今天的重點是釋放過去，並將目光投向未來。一個新的人可能會進入你的生活，在這個旅程中提供支持。預計與朋友和家人進行有意義的對話，可能會導致比平時更多的電話。迎接這一天，期待著等待你的令人興奮的可能性！
aquarius.horoscope_en: Aquarius, today is all about releasing the past and setting your sights on what lies ahead. A new individual might enter your life, offering support in this journey. Expect to engage in meaningful conversations with friends and family, possibly leading to more phone calls than usual. Embrace this day as you look forward to the exciting possibilities that await you!

pisces.horoscope: 擁有一個家是有挑戰的！雙魚座，雖然你對專案的熱情很強烈，但無盡的雜務清單可能會抑制你的熱情。你的家很穩固，但可能需要修繕一下。不妨考慮引進一些室內植物和花卉，為旅居增添活力。在外面，幾個放置良好的盆栽可以作為美麗的亮點。你可以創造一個可愛的轉型，而不會破產或付出太多努力。
pisces.horoscope_en: Owning a home has its challenges! While your passion for projects is strong, Pisces, the endless list of chores can dampen your enthusiasm. Your home is solid, but it could use a little sprucing up. Consider bringing in some indoor plants and flowers to liven up the space. Outside, a few well-placed pots can serve as beautiful highlights. You can create a lovely transformation without breaking the bank or putting in too much effort.
